purpose: Apply the frozen H2 home-field release to every game in the current active Graham week in shadow, explicitly classify venue type, preserve all non-location football adjustments and personnel overlays, and determine the proper scope for any later H4 production activation without changing the live board.
governingRules: H3 is shadow-only and may not mutate current Graham fairs, carried power ratings, personnel ledgers, or the player-value registry.
For a normal domestic home game, replace only the existing live location term with the H2 location term in shadow. All other exact fair components remain unchanged.
For a neutral or international-neutral game, the base home-location term is zero unless a later governed venue-specific differential is explicitly accepted.
Personnel overlays, QB uncertainty, weather, rest, travel, time-zone, surface and other non-HFA factors may not be absorbed into HFA or recomputed by H3.
Market data may not be used to classify, calibrate, accept, reject or tune an H3 result.
H3 must produce both a league-baseline shadow and a team/venue shadow so the H4 scope decision can distinguish evidence for a general league HFA from evidence for team-specific deviations.

A team/venue estimate may not receive H4 production candidacy merely because it changes a displayed Graham number; H2 chronological validation remains the governing evidence for whether team-specific deviations improve out-of-sample prediction.
Exact internal arithmetic is preserved before half-point display rounding.

venueClassificationPolicy.source: Pinned H2 nflverse filtered schedule snapshot plus current active-board identity.
venueClassificationPolicy.DOMESTIC_HOME: Snapshot location=Home and the game is not a shared-venue opponent matchup or otherwise specially classified.
venueClassificationPolicy.NEUTRAL: Snapshot location=Neutral at a domestic neutral site.
venueClassificationPolicy.INTERNATIONAL_NEUTRAL: Snapshot location=Neutral at an international venue; base home-location advantage remains zero.
venueClassificationPolicy.SHARED_VENUE_OR_METRO: If both opponents share the same governed home stadium/metro, do not blindly use normal home value; fail closed unless explicitly resolved.
venueClassificationPolicy.RELOCATED_HOME: A designated home game at a non-governed home venue requires explicit review and cannot inherit the normal team estimate automatically.
venueClassificationPolicy.UNRESOLVED: Any schedule identity or venue classification ambiguity fails closed.

acceptanceRequirements: H2 state is PASS_CURRENT_CALIBRATION_SHADOW_RELEASE with validationPass=true.
Every active-week game matches exactly one H2 snapshot record by season, home team and away team.
Every active-week game receives an explicit venue class with no unresolved classifications.
Every domestic home team has exactly one H2 team/venue estimate.
The current live location adjustment is identifiable and consistent with the active-board venue class.
Every shadow exact fair is reproducible by replacing only the location term.
Personnel overlays and all protected live artifacts remain byte-identical during H3.
Market isolation remains false/clean throughout H3.

h4ScopeDecisionRule.leagueBaselineCandidate: May advance when H2 chronological validation passed and H3 has no unresolved active-week venue or arithmetic cases.
h4ScopeDecisionRule.teamVenueCandidate: May advance only if the H2 team/venue candidate is no worse than the H2 league-only model on BOTH held-out domestic MAE and RMSE and H3 has no unresolved venue/arithmetic cases.
h4ScopeDecisionRule.teamVenueIfNotSuperior: Remain shadow/diagnostic even if individual Week 1 team-specific numbers appear intuitive or materially different.
h4ScopeDecisionRule.neutralPolicyCandidate: Zero base HFA for explicit neutral/international-neutral games may advance if identity/classification is resolved.
